## About

<div class="intro">

I am a Ph.D. student in **Economics at Yale University**. 

I am interested in **econometric theory and applied econometrics**, particularly causal inference and learning in settings where agents interact or respond strategically.

My interests also often intersect with learning theory and algorithmic game theory/mechanism design ([EconCS](https://www.bowaggoner.com/whatiseconcs.html){target="_blank"}). 

</div>
